learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with experience and knowledge of technical English.
Make students ready to use English sources of information for later study and professional career.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental vocabulary through selected topics in mathematics, physics and informatics
assessment_rules: Grades are given as follows: A for 93%, B for 85%, C for 77%, D for 70%, E for 65%. The scale of assessment is 100% preliminary, 0% final.
bibliography: Anglický jazyk pre študentov FMFI UK : Kurz pre mierne pokročilých / Alena Zemanová. The textbook has not been published. It is at students' disposal in an electronic format.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
